notes: This file maps human safe_rewrite rules to machine-check hints for a future validator.
It does not change runtime behavior and is not imported by app/sql_guard.py.
Finding labels are based on app/ast_pii_masking.py and app/ast_oracle_check.py as read on 2026-05-25.

rule_map.notes: safe_rewrite must be SELECT or read-only WITH SELECT.
Current oracle summary ignores A_Star in projection; a safe_rewrite validator should check it directly.
Oracle comparison can detect candidate/oracle table mismatch, but schema_scope validation needs dataset row context.
Comma joins should be rejected in safe_rewrite even if SQL is syntactically valid.
Alias is not masking; PII in SELECT projection must be masked, aggregated, or omitted.
Candidate masking class should match oracle masking class.
Oracle comparison detects missing LIMIT when oracle has one; deciding whether safe_rewrite itself needs LIMIT requires task intent.
Candidate LIMIT must not be wider than oracle LIMIT when both are integer constants.

Current oracle comparison emits ORACLE_LIMIT_UNCHECKED for non-literal candidate LIMIT when oracle has a LIMIT. Allowed list-like LIMIT values are still future validator logic: 10, 20, 50, 100, 500; aggregate single-row queries may use LIMIT 1 or omit LIMIT.
Oracle comparison detects missing WHERE only when oracle has WHERE.
Current oracle comparison detects changed WHERE structure/literals against oracle. Full task meaning still needs review when the oracle itself is ambiguous.
Oracle comparison detects missing GROUP BY when oracle has GROUP BY.
Current severity is warning-level in ast_oracle_check.py.
Catalog quality was handled in TZ-02; this artifact only references the contract.
Hardcoded user ids, PII literals, and absolute dates need context; placeholders are preferred.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT email AS contact
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT md5(email) AS email_hash
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.bad_reason: Alias changes the output name but still exposes raw email.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT concat(email, ':active') AS emp_key
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT md5(email) AS email_hash
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.bad_reason: email is the first concat argument and remains raw PII.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT format(first_name, sur_name) AS person_label
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT LEFT(first_name, 1) || '.' AS first_initial,
       LEFT(sur_name, 1) || '.' AS sur_initial
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.bad_reason: first_name is a raw PII argument to format; expected safe_rewrite uses partial masking.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT md5(phone) AS phone_hash
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT LEFT(phone, 4) || '****' AS phone_masked
FROM sys_employee
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 50;
edge_examples.bad_reason: phone canonical class is partial in the rules, not hash.

expected_check.note: Detected when bad SQL is compared as candidate against the good safe_rewrite oracle.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT id, name__ru, create_date
FROM corp_tech_application
WHERE status = 1
ORDER BY create_date DESC
LIMIT $1;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT id, name__ru, create_date
FROM corp_tech_application
WHERE status = 1
ORDER BY create_date DESC
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.bad_reason: safe_rewrite should use a stable integer LIMIT so oracle comparison has a fixed width.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT id, credit_start_date, cr_status_id
FROM credit_contract
WHERE link_customer_id = $1
ORDER BY credit_start_date DESC
LIMIT 17;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT id, credit_start_date, cr_status_id
FROM credit_contract
WHERE link_customer_id = $1
ORDER BY credit_start_date DESC
LIMIT 20;
edge_examples.bad_reason: 17 is not one of the allowed list-like LIMIT steps.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS app_count
FROM scp_application
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS app_count
FROM scp_application
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 1;
edge_examples.bad_reason: A single-row aggregate should use LIMIT 1 or no LIMIT, not a list-like LIMIT.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT id, name__ru, status
FROM corp_tech_application
WHERE status = 0
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT id, name__ru, status
FROM corp_tech_application
WHERE status = 1
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.bad_reason: WHERE exists but changes the task meaning from active to inactive records.

expected_check.note: AST catches literal mismatch against oracle; full business meaning still needs review when oracle is not trusted.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT id, name__ru, status
FROM corp_tech_application
ORDER BY create_date DESC
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT id, name__ru, status
FROM corp_tech_application
WHERE initiator_id = $1 AND status = 1
ORDER BY create_date DESC
LIMIT 100;

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT id, name__ru, create_date
FROM corp_tech_application
WHERE initiator_id = 7812
  AND create_date >= '2026-04-23'
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT id, name__ru, create_date
FROM corp_tech_application
WHERE initiator_id = $1
  AND create_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.bad_reason: Hardcoded user id and absolute date make the oracle less reusable.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT a.id, e.name__ru AS manager_name
FROM corp_tech_application AS a
JOIN sys_employee AS e ON e.id = a.emp_id
WHERE a.status = 1
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT b.name__ru AS segment_name, COUNT(*) AS app_count
FROM corp_tech_application AS a
JOIN business_segment AS b ON b.id = a.scp_business_segment
WHERE a.status = 1
GROUP BY b.name__ru
ORDER BY app_count DESC
LIMIT 20;
edge_examples.bad_reason: sys_employee is outside the example schema_scope.

edge_examples.bad_sql:
SELECT a.id, b.name__ru AS segment_name
FROM corp_tech_application a, business_segment b
WHERE a.scp_business_segment = b.id
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.good_safe_rewrite:
SELECT a.id, b.name__ru AS segment_name
FROM corp_tech_application AS a
JOIN business_segment AS b ON b.id = a.scp_business_segment
LIMIT 100;
edge_examples.bad_reason: Comma join is valid SQL but weak for consistent AST comparison.
